newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Oil Search sees Kutubu decline.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Oil Search sees Kutubu decline.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Oil Search Ltd said on Friday its share of crude oil production in the Kutubu field in Papua New Guinea fell to 708,247 barrels in the 1996 December quarter.
The result compared with 779,100 barrels in the September quarter and was due to a natural decline in the fields, it said.
Operating revenue totalled A$20.35 million, up 11 percent on the September quarter.
"The increase in revenue (was) due to a rise in average realised oil prices to US$22.59, up from US$20.15 in the September period," Oil Search said in its quarterly report.
Oil Search said its share of gas production from the Hides project in PNG for the quarter totalled 61.2 million cubic feet, a marginal decrease on the previous quarter.
